Specialized Skillset

Core Proficiencies

Practical, in-depth expertise across infrastructure provisioning, system automation, Linux internals, and technical inquiry.

TF Provisioning

Terraform

Expertise in declarative cloud architecture using HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL). Writing reusable, DRY module structures, managing remote state backends with state locking, handling workspaces, and remediating configuration drift.

Key Competencies:

HCL Modules Remote State State Locking Drift Remediation
SH Scripting

Bash Scripting

Writing robust POSIX and Bash automation scripts for server administration, CI/CD pipeline orchestration, cron maintenance, log parsing, and system bootstrap. Deeply practiced in defensive scripting, exit codes, and text stream manipulation.

Key Competencies:

POSIX Compliance awk / sed / grep Task Automation Defensive Scripting
LX Systems

Linux Administration

Comprehensive systems engineering across Debian, Ubuntu, and enterprise Linux distributions. Proficient in systemd daemon services, user access controls (RBAC/sudoers), storage & volume layout, networking stack, firewalls, and OS hardening.

Key Competencies:

systemd Daemons OS Hardening UFW / iptables Performance Tuning
IaC Architecture

Infrastructure as Code

Treating systems architecture with software engineering discipline. Advocating for immutable infrastructure paradigms, version-controlled repository workflows, automated pre-flight linting, deterministic environment parity, and zero snowflake configurations.

Key Competencies:

GitOps Workflows Immutable Infra Environment Parity Automated Validation
TR Analysis

Technical Research

Executing thorough investigative research into systems architecture, emerging cloud tooling, security vulnerabilities, and deployment patterns. Translating technical findings into actionable documentation, runbooks, and proof-of-concept implementations.

Key Competencies:

Tooling Benchmarks Architecture Docs PoC Testing Systems Documentation
EP Philosophy

Engineering Principles

Striving for zero manual overhead. Every server configuration should be auditable in source control, every deployment should be repeatable on demand, and every architectural choice should be grounded in evidence and measurable results.

Guiding Standards:

Zero Snowflakes Least Privilege Documented Runbooks

How I Approach Engineering

A structured, repeatable methodology from initial investigation to production delivery.

STAGE 01

1. Deep-Dive Research

Evaluating infrastructure requirements, benchmarking candidate tooling, assessing failure modes, and establishing crystal-clear documentation before provisioning.

STAGE 02

2. Codify & Automate

Translating architecture into modular Terraform HCL scripts and defensive Bash automation routines with integrated validation checks.

STAGE 03

3. Harden & Operate

Enforcing Linux system security baselines, setting up continuous monitoring and alerting hooks, and delivering comprehensive operator runbooks.
